when: Malformed or out-of-range input, a body over the size limit (`field: body`; there is no `413`), a page token issued to another caller or for another operation; `details.fields[]` lists `{field, reason}`
Valid caller without the permission, including a signed-in caller with no team binding on a route not scoped to one team (CD-10); `details.requiredPermission`
No such resource, **or** a resource in a team the caller cannot see (never reveals existence), **or** an unknown path or `:verb` (error envelope, not a bare 404)
Returned by `afs-gateway` to agents only, never by `afs-api`; not retryable (see [gateway contract](gateway-contract.md))
Duplicate name, idempotency body mismatch or in progress, dependent objects exist, invalid state transition (for example a suspended team)
`If-Match` missing on `PATCH` or `DELETE` of an existing resource (optional on `PUT`)
Returned by `afs-gateway` only, when Bedrock returns a server error; the reservation is released; retry with backoff
Dependency down (database, Secrets Manager); safe to retry with backoff
